audit_items.proof_trace: All three public liquidation paths (handle_liquidation, handle_debt_auto_deleverage, handle_collateral_auto_deleverage) route exclusively through liquidation_inner, which calls ensure_liquidate_borrow_allowed before any repayment; the function asserts liquidator_repay_amount <= debt_balance * close_factor (token-denominated, semantically equivalent to the USD formulation). Both bypasses are properly gated: bad_debt bypass requires collateral_total_value <= 1.01 * debts_total_value (L985-992), and small_position bypass requires debt_value (ceiled USD) <= close_factor_bypass_min_value (L1006). close_factor is bounded to (0,1] by admin-level validation on all entry points, and interest is accrued before the check, so debt_balance is always current.
